essence: The passage introduces the measure of ordinary human years as the basis for reckoning.
The total span is obtained by computing these large time units together with the factor seventy-one.
By implication, the calculated years are to be understood as divine years.
The period in question has been declared to have a thousandfold measure.
The evening period is identified as the time of twilight.
